annotations.title: Working at height checklist and job risk note

description: Builds the working at height and scaffold checklist for a roofing job (hierarchy of controls, scaffold to TG20 with guardrails, 7-day inspections, ladders only for short work, roof ladders, flat roof edges, fragile surfaces, power lines, highway licences, hot works, asbestos, rescue), the CDM 2015 duties (construction phase plan, domestic client, F10 notification test), a scored risk register (likelihood x severity) and a short risk note ready to print. From the Work at Height Regulations 2005, CDM 2015 and free HSE guidance. Typical call: {"job_type":"re_roof","eaves_height_m":5.5,"pitch_deg":35,"duration_days":5,"workers":3,"access":"scaffold","next_to_public_highway":true}.

eaves_height_m.description: Height to the eaves from the ground, metres.

fragile_surfaces.description: Rooflights, old cement sheets or other fragile materials on or near the work.

hot_works.description: Torch-on felt or other hot works.

trade.description: Optional. The roofer's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to put the contractor on risk notes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Ridge Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Hilltop Roofing".

licence_body.description: Competent person scheme or trade body the business is registered with (CompetentRoofer is the roofing scheme run by the NFRC).

workers.description: Most people on site at once. Default 2.
